manifest.name: Message assistant (Qwen2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M)
manifest.description: Sorts everyday messages, such as texts and emails, by topic and writes one-sentence summaries. English and Spanish.

operations.title: Sort by topic
operations.when: sort the message into one topic category, such as family, work, money, shopping or travel
examples: Your order of running shoes has shipped and will arrive on Wednesday.
Your electricity bill of $84.20 is due on March 3. Pay online before then to avoid a late fee.
Your train to Berlin leaves from platform 7 in 20 minutes.

prompt.system: You sort everyday messages, such as texts and emails, by topic. Answer with exactly one category from this list: {{labels}}.

labels.description: plans, invitations and greetings from friends
colleagues, managers, clients, meetings and deadlines

operations.title: Summarize
operations.when: shorten the text into a brief summary
examples: Hi Sam, because of a storm your flight to Lisbon on Friday will leave two hours late, at 16:40. Your seat and bags stay the same.
Tu vuelo a Lisboa del viernes se retrasa dos horas por una tormenta. La nueva hora de salida es las 16:40.
Your electricity bill of $84.20 is due on March 3. Pay online before then to avoid a late fee.

prompt.system: You summarize a message in one short sentence written in {{language}}. Keep the key facts. Do not add anything.

memory_mb.notes: file size + KV cache + compute buffers, CPU/WASM
